name: Image strip into text
what: A strip of wide image cards slides across the middle of a dark frame, starting slowly, racing past in a sideways smear and slowing again as the last card slides out to the left; then a line of text in a glow slides in from the right and settles in the middle.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f3-f35 the strip slides in from the right and speeds up (from 9 to 290 px a frame at 1280 wide), f35-f70 it slows down again and the last card slides out to the left; the sideways motion blur follows its speed; f56-f89 the text slides in from the right and settles in the middle (decelerating); then it holds to the end

tracks.name: strip
tracks.what: eight cards slide left along the middle, speeding up then slowing down (speed peaks at f35)

tracks.name: blur
tracks.what: a sideways-only blur whose size follows the strip's speed

tracks.name: text
tracks.what: slides in from the right edge and settles in the middle, with a glow

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the text stays still (the film grain moves)
